proposed_capability: P83 P03 P141 P124 P04 closer: reconcile merged single-click launch against existing multiple executables in one Sims install and fail-closed Windows process evidence; repair without auto loading protected saves.
player_save_control_impact: Do not scan, read, choose, modify or overwrite user saves or automatically Resume. Explicit double-click is launch admission only. Unknown process inventory blocks new launch.
expected_outcome: Same Game/Bin folder containing TS4_x64.exe and TS4.exe auto chooses validated 64-bit executable; distinct installation paths remain ambiguous; malformed tasklist or spoofed inventory does not allow launch or misreport a trusted game PID; manual chooser remains player-controlled.
negative_tests: Two TS4 executables from one valid install do not falsely cause ambiguity
Two distinct game directories remain ambiguous
Malformed tasklist output with no valid CSV process rows denies
Missing/malformed PID and duplicate PID deny
Second process check must be a validated dict not arbitrary falsey input
Untrusted postdispatch inventory cannot be promoted as observed game PID
Never choose or mutate any save or click game menus
rollback_path: Revert closer's scoped scripts/smart_start.py, tests/test_smart_start.py and docs without reverting #200; manual chooser and save policy remain intact.
unresolved_unknowns: Actual Windows EA/Steam/Epic game version and runtime PID/path identity on user's machine
Per-machine recent-save trust, calibrated menu and player takeover from issue #201
Physical Windows game process startup and duplicate concurrent double-click observation
decision_rationale: P83 found a reproducible one-install/two-executable false-negative and fail-open process evidence; P03 repairs bounded source; P141 selects existing-owner hardening over speculative latest-save menu click automation; P124 keeps one script owner; P04 leaves physically blocked Windows proof in existing Issue #201.
